The Problem We Solve

Building on blockchain requires massive infrastructure investment:

  • Node Infrastructure — Running reliable RPC endpoints across multiple chains
  • Data Infrastructure — Indexing, storing, and querying petabytes of blockchain data
  • Analytics Infrastructure — Processing and visualizing on-chain metrics
  • Growth Infrastructure — Understanding and engaging wallet-level users

Most organizations either build this themselves (expensive, slow) or cobble together multiple vendors (fragmented, unreliable).

Numia provides a unified enterprise cloud that handles all of this — production-ready, multi-chain, and built for institutional requirements.

Who Uses Numia

Our cloud infrastructure powers leading players across the blockchain ecosystem:

Client Type Examples
Data Platforms Token Terminal, Dune, Nansen, CoinGecko, DefiLlama, DexScreener
